propositions: Attestations with UNDECLARED file_impact currently invalidate on ANY code-SHA change, causing false-positive re-reviews (21% of full reviews on byte-identical material).
The read-set (normalized file paths fetched during plan review) must be recorded in the signed manifest, deduplicated, normalized to repo-relative POSIX form, and excluded if nonexistent.

SHA drift invalidation should scope to read-set ∪ blast-radius (criteria and workflow configs) ONLY when the pre-existing dependency set is empty, container is not poisoned, scope is UNDECLARED, and a read-set was recorded.
Globs in the blast radius must be expanded at attestation time to individual dep entries, and also recorded as a membership digest to catch addition/deletion of matching files.
Legacy attestations lacking a read-set field, unverifiable read-sets, and expansion failures fall back to invalidate-on-any-change (fail-safe behavior).
The currency basis (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) must be reported in plan_review_status output and recorded in the signed manifest.
